title: Lior and the Confession
author: August Sterling
blurb: Tamsin Sterling, an estate lawyer reading a will that shouldn't exist, thought they had seen every way a life can end. Then a client pays in advance to prove a murder hasn't happened — yet — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now he must trap a killer who knows the case file better than the investigators do, and time is already running out.
style: vivid, cinematic prose with tight pacing
